rows.backtranslation: Choose a size smaller than this for the output copy. The original/source images and crop settings remain at the original size in pixels.
rows.context_and_review_note: Added xef ta (smaller than this) so the instruction is comparative, not simply choose a small size. Corrected qqimn to qqimnt: both coordinated subjects, tiwlafin and tisɣal, are feminine plural. Original size in pixels is a functional resolution paraphrase, not screen magnification, JPEG quality or a promise that the reduced output retains original detail. AssemblyActivity.kt:305 shows this before choosing a separate output size; :319–330 creates an independent PNG and either returns it to Paint or launches Save PNG. AssemblyRenderer.kt renders into a new bitmap; destination maps original layout to output coordinates and decodeCrop reads source/crop settings without modifying their stored geometry or source files. Export/output here names the produced copy in BOTH workflows, not only external file export. No source deletion, crop rewrite, or all-source-originals-included claim is introduced.

rows.backtranslation: Enter valid values for width and height.
rows.context_and_review_note: Retained valid data/values for width and height. isfka is broad but clear with explicitly named dimension fields; iṣḥan is the relative valid predicate, not a claim that any positive value is accepted. AssemblyActivity.kt:311 selects this message only when DimensionControls.dimensions is null, before a separate renderer.fits admission check; :312 disables Create output for null or over-budget sizes. Thus invalid values are not conflated with RAM insufficiency. Pixel integrality, finite positivity and bounds are enforced by DimensionControls; the label need not enumerate them or add a numeric upper bound.
